title: Promise and Letters
author: August Eastwick
blurb: Rosalind Galloway, a lighthouse keeper's granddaughter and part-time novelist, keeps love in the past tense where it belongs. But when the person behind a decade of letters moves in next door, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now she must forgive the person in the mirror first, and time is already running out.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
